suite: isolated PostgreSQL 17, separate ephemeral clusters on loopback, ordinary source tests
case: 2257 owner interrupt keeps its exact superseded run cancelled when a heartbeat revocation arrives first

before.note: Subsequent watchdog assertions in this initial test runner also failed. The final regression is placed after those scenarios, where all 37 checks passed.

coverage: wrong device returns null with no state change
authenticated supersession + lease revocation persists cancelled/cancelled
actual independent device credential revocation leaves failed/device_lost even if owner epoch changed

exposure.impact: The old conversation attempt shows a device failure following an ordinary owner replacement. The replacement ran, and queued input did not leak into it.
